description: Native consumer regressions supplementing, not modifying, the official 4.1 fixture set

tests.name: root keyed values recursively follow the first schema without reordering entry keys
nested groups reorder every schema level but preserve outer field order
anonymous nested uniform arrays retain each list object's encounter order
first keyed field in list object keeps deeper entry rows and shallower siblings
tests.expected:
[2]:
  - users[2:]{age}:
      alice: 1
      bob: 2
    tail: end
  - false

tests.name: tab delimiter affects anonymous zero header but not field empty-array shorthand
late nested null invalidation cannot publish a speculative keyed header
tests.expected:
z:
  meta:
    id: 1
a:
  meta:
    id: 2
last:
  meta: null

tests.name: quoted keyed entry names and literal dotted group fields remain literal
empty anonymous objects and arrays are not table candidates
